review_notes.note: 若患者有呼吸困難、胸痛、心悸或意識不清等嚴重症狀，可能為急性中毒或過敏性休克，應優先啟動緊急醫療流程，而非僅填寫問卷。
若懷疑為故意服用，需評估患者的精神狀態與自殺風險。問卷僅為初步資料收集，應由專業人員進行後續評估。

rag_sources.title: Trichomoniasis: Background, Pathophysiology, Etiology
rag_sources.excerpt: Trichomoniasis is thought to be widely underdiagnosed owing to various factors, including a lack of routine testing, the low sensitivity of a commonly used diagnostic technique (wet mount microscopy), and nonspecific symptomatology. Self-diagnosis and self-treatment or diagnosis by practitioners without adequate laboratory testing may also contribute to misdiagnosis. rag_sources.title: Food Allergies: Practice Essentials, Background, Pathophysiology
rag_sources.excerpt: most common clinical manifestations of an allergic reaction to a food or food additive. Symptoms range from acute urticaria (most common) to flushing to angioedema to exacerbations of atopic dermatitis. Food allergy is rarely the cause of chronic urticaria or angioedema. Atopic dermatitis Controversy surrounds the role of food allergy in the pathogenesis of atopic dermatitis. Studies show that among patients with moderate chronic atopic dermatitis, 35-40% have IgE-mediated food allergy. Food-specific IgE-mediated and cellular mechanisms appear responsible for chronic eczematous inflammation.
